### 👨‍💻 Introduction

<details open>
<summary><b>👋 About Me</b></summary>
<br/>

Hey there! 👋 I'm **Ang Kimsor**, a MIS student at **SETEC Institute** in Cambodia.

My academic journey covers a rich blend of tech disciplines—including **software development**, **systems & business analysis**, **computer networking**, and **digital media production**. This broad foundation enables me to analyze challenges with both technical precision and a strategic business mindset.

- 🎓 **Studies:** Management Information Systems (MIS) at **SETEC Institute**.
- 🎯 **Core Focus:** Designing and developing **business systems and web applications** that solve **real-world business challenges**.
- 🚀 **Main Goal:** Bridging business needs with modern technology to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-impact digital solutions that drive practical business value.
